details.name: Zhuang Fangyi
details.quote: Endmin, before I officially come on board, I'd like to say a few words. As Viceroy, I am experienced in administrative duties. However ... here in Endfield, I wish to serve as a regular Tianshi and focus on research.
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Erudite: Prodigy Her knowledge is vast and her experience extensive. She is often the first to figure out a solution in difficult times.
details.exp2d: Team Management: Empathizer She is attentive to every detail when welcoming guests and handling various tasks. Working with her is like basking in the spring breeze.
details.hb1d: Charity: Guardian A single heart beats within her, yet it alone has space enough for the entire city and everyone living in it.
details.hb2d: Culture: Sunrise Industry She has plans for the future of Wuling, and they go far beyond Xiranite technology.
details.matskill: Lone Barge, Flickers in the Mist, Oblivion
